title: Questionnaire for research into secure behaviour with mobile digital devices

contacts.name: Blix, M.E.
contacts.affiliation: The Hague University of Applied Sciences

descriptions: This file set contains a questionnaire. The questionnaire aims to investigate the factors and aspects that can influence the secure behaviour of inviduals while using mobile digital devices, such as smartphones, tablets or laptops.
